sentences.en: Mr Brown contracted with the builder for a new house.
sentences.zh: 布朗先生与建筑商签订了新建房屋的合同。

sentences.en: Mr Johnson suddenly changed his mind and signed the contract.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊先生突然改变主意并签了合同。

sentences.en: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
sentences.zh: 你必须在签字之前仔细阅读合同。
